svg.title: Influencer engagement and retention · Follow engagement into observed return behavior
svg.desc: Proposed extension · not performed. Extend the survey model with time ordering and permissioned behavioral data. Proposed workflow. No new data or model results are claimed.

g.text: Follow engagement into observed return behavior

g.title: Measure antecedents before engagement and later return outcomes. Check whether the constructs retain comparable meaning across waves.
With consent, join survey responses to defined return events. Specify an observation window and distinguish a revisit from an engaged return.
Use longitudinal SEM for the construct pathway and a prespecified binary or survival model for return events. An ML benchmark is optional when data volume supports it.
Evaluate the return model on a later period, with people kept separate across training and evaluation. Report attrition and uncertainty in the longitudinal paths.

g.text: Proposed workflow. No new data or model results are claimed.
